title: Social and Spatiotemporal Impacts of Casino Jackpot Events
near_miss_reason: Jackpots occur at different times, but the only DiD is an event-aligned (stacked) design: each jackpot defines a before/after window, with customer x jackpot FE (mjp_id), slot-machine FE and date-hour FE, after_jackpot common within each event, and three treatment arms (after x winner, after x peer, after x bystander) in one regression; the bet-amount regression also conditions on the previous play's bet and winnings (lagged outcome). Stacked-only plus extra treatment regressors and lagged outcomes; moot for replication because the package ships simulated data only.
eligible_reason: Stacked event-window design around each jackpot (customer x jackpot FE), with three treatment-group interactions estimated jointly and lagged bet/earnings controls in the bet-amount regression; SAS proc genmod on manually demeaned data. Package ships simulated data only.
design_notes: Jackpot_Code.sas: within-transformation by mjp_id (customer x jackpot), slotnumber and time (date-hour), then proc genmod with after_jp, after_jp x winner/peer/bystander, pre_betmoney, pre_earned; clustered by customer x jackpot. Number-of-plays regression analogous without slot FE.
data_files_note: README and code comments: simulated data that resembles the casino player-tracking data used in the paper.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available; screened from the 7z archive contents (extracted to scratchpad for reading only) and OpenAlex abstract. Regression inventory was empty because the code sits inside a 7z archive.
